Motioned by Stroik/Luedtke to Approve the Planning & Zoning Meeting Minutes
of October 12, 2026 and the Village Board Meeting Minutes of October 12, 2026
as Presented. Questioned and carried 7:0.
7. Discussion and Possible Action Regarding Proposed Replat of Cedar Creek Haven,
Generally Located Along Cedar Haven Trail and Eagle Nest Boulevard:
Mrs. Borchardt explained that the Cedar Creek Haven Subdivision was previously
approved as a mixed-use development consisting of townhomes, single-family homes,
twin homes, and a single commercial development. The subdivision also includes
areas designated for public walking trails and stormwater management facilities.
During the construction of the subdivision, the Village noticed that portions of the
existing public walking trail were constructed outside of the originally established
public outlot boundaries and extend onto lots intended for single-family residential
development. This discrepancy resulted from an error in the original planning of the
trail location related to DNR requirements concerning construction near the ordinary
high-water mark and associated stormwater runoff. As a result, portions of the trail
were constructed outside of the originally designated public outlot to accommodate
these requirements. If these residential lots were sold prior to correcting the
boundaries, portions of the public walking trail would be located on privately owned
property, potentially restricting the Village's and public's ability to access, use, and
maintain the trail as originally intended. The developer has submitted a proposed
replat of Cedar Creek Haven Subdivision to modify the existing lot and outlot
boundaries to better reflect the current development layout and existing public
improvements. The proposed replat has also been submitted to the Wisconsin
Department of Administration (DOA) for review and approval.
1

The proposed replat is generally consistent with the previously approved plat and it
brings all public use areas into the outlot, therefore Mrs. Borchardt recommends
approval of the replat of Cedar Creek Haven Subdivision.
Motioned by Kennedy/Schremp to Approve the Proposed Replat of Cedar Creek
Haven, Generally Located Along Cedar Haven Trail and Eagle Nest Boulevard as
Presented. Questioned and carried 7:0.
